requirements.statement: Capture a complete, accountable shift handover without duplicate transcription.
requirements.bottleneck: The outgoing worker re-enters the same state into several unlinked records.
requirements.intervention: Create one signed handover event that supplies each downstream record.
requirements.verification: Run a simulated handover and confirm each required record receives the same event ID.

components.name: Signed handover event
components.purpose: Captures the outgoing worker's accountable handover.

components.name: Record distributor
components.purpose: Routes the event to permitted operational records.

evidence.claim: Duplicate entry occurs in the synthetic operating scenario.
Care teams will accept a single signed event.
evidence.falsification_test: Five user interviews and a supervised simulated handover.

open_items.statement: Validate acceptance in a real care setting.
